### The Everlasting King
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/everlasting-king
Passage: Psalm 145:13
Points:
- Earthly human empires inevitably crumble, but God's sovereign throne and reign endure throughout all generations.
- The Lord rules universally over all creation, regardless of whether rebellious humanity acknowledges His sovereignty.
- God exercises His authority with generosity and mercy, showing patience and providing sustenance for all living things.
- Believers have the special assurance that the eternal King hears their prayers and grants them salvation.
- Because His eternal reign will never fall, believers can follow and serve Him boldly without fear of failure.
